desc.en: Dua of Imam Ali (a) on completing the recitation of the Holy Quraan <Allaahum-mashrah bil-Quraane>
desc.rurdu: Khatm’e Quraan par Imam Ali (a) ki dua <Allaahum-mashrah bil-Quraane>
desc.urdu: ختم قرآن پر امام علیؑ کی دعا <اَللّٰهُمَّ اشْرَحْ بِالْقُرْآنِ>

desc.en: Short dua on completing the recitation of the Holy Quraan <Allaahumma Aanis Wah-Shatee>
desc.rurdu: Khatm’e Quraan ki mukhtasar dua <Allaahumma Aanis Wah-Shatee>
desc.urdu: ختم قرآن کی مختصر دعا <اَللّٰهُمَّ اٰنِسْ وَحْشَتِیْ>

desc.en: On completing Quran recite dua of <Sahifa-e-Sajjadiya-42>.
desc.rurdu: Khatm'e Quraan par <Sahifa-e-Sajjadiya-42> ki dua padhe.
